trust.summary: Trust and safety notes — read before running
trust.projectCode: Only run projects you trust. Commands may execute project and lifecycle code with your user permissions. npm 12 may skip dependency scripts even when the command succeeds, unless the root allowScripts permits them; root and explicitly run scripts still execute, and root preinstall runs before dependencies are installed. Inspect allowScripts yourself; the app does not approve scripts, rebuild packages or recover missing build artifacts.
trust.config: Configuration in .npmrc, pnpmfile and plugins may execute code or affect tool behavior. Strict npm configuration may make the command fail; the app adds no ignore-scripts, allow-scripts or strict-npmrc overrides and does not retry automatically.
trust.network: Commands may use the network, shared stores and access or change files outside the project.
trust.logs: Logs may reveal secrets; filtering cannot guarantee removal of every secret.
trust.noRollback: There is no rollback. Stopping or failure may still leave partial changes.
trust.stop: Stopping may miss processes that escape the tracked process tree.
trust.path: Replacing the target path during startup is not fully prevented.

outcome.refreshRequired: Updating project data after the command did not finish or requires a manual refresh. Refresh context and project details to view updated state.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Shared tokens and components for the interface. Every sample reads straight from the active theme: switch Light/Dark or the language in the top bar to see it change.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The PkgSteward mark pairs a floating isometric package cube with a protective cradle on a rounded red badge, using semantic logo tokens so it matches the app icon and favicon.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Same shape as the app icon in the browser tab. The navigation bar uses the 32px size.

lockup.title: Logo with name
lockup.description: The icon sits before the two-tone wordmark, 8px apart: bold red "Pkg" paired with theme foreground ink for "Steward" so the lockup stays legible in both light and dark modes.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Background/foreground pairs of the active preset, shown side by side in both modes. Components use token names only, never color codes.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not color. The main typeface is Inter.
typography.sample: Scan and clean up the Node.js projects on this machine
typography.monoNote: Only for command logs, paths and version numbers

shape.title: Shape and spacing
shape.description: Corner radius, shadow, spacing and content width shared by every screen.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: The whole scale derives from the active preset's --radius variable: change that one variable and every corner follows.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Cards sit flat. Only modals and floating layers (menus, selects) cast a shadow.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: 8px base step; 4px and 6px are for tight gaps inside chips. Sections are 32px apart on mobile, 48px on tablet and 64px on desktop.

container.title: Content width
container.description: Content is at most 1280px wide, with 16px side gutters on mobile and 24px from 640px up.

actions.title: Buttons and badges
actions.description: Buttons are 40px tall with corners following --radius. Badges are pill-shaped with 12px bold text.

buttons.title: Button
buttons.description: Each screen has at most one default (red) button for its main action; everything else uses secondary. Each row shows sizes sm, default, lg, icon-sm, icon, icon-lg and the disabled state. On real screens, always wrap icon-only buttons in a Tooltip.

badges.title: Badge
badges.description: For short statuses: versions, dependency types, vulnerabilities.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Inputs are 44px tall; on focus they get a 2px inner border and a 4px blue outer ring. Press Tab to see it.

input.title: Input and Label
input.invalidMessage: Invalid version. Use 1.2.3 or a range like ^1.2.0.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Checked boxes use the text color, not red.

select.title: Select
select.description: Sizes default and sm, with groups, a locked item and the disabled state.

toggleGroup.title: ToggleGroup (filter chip)
toggleGroup.description: Pill-shaped chips that invert when selected. Used to filter lists.

data.title: Data display
data.description: Cards, tables, tabs, and loading and empty states.

card.title: Card
card.description: Card background (cream in light mode), no border, no shadow. Sizes default and sm.

table.description: Bold column headers and a hairline under each row. Wide tables scroll horizontally inside their frame.

progress.description: Progress bars use the text color, not red.

job.title: Activity and logs
job.continues: Activity continues when the tab is hidden or you leave this page. Use Stop to request termination.
job.startUnknown: It is unclear whether the request was accepted. Refresh status manually; the operation is not resent automatically.
job.cancelUnknown: The stop result is unconfirmed. Refresh status before requesting further cleanup.
job.lost: The backend no longer tracks this activity. This does not prove that processes stopped or global packages are unchanged. Check Task Manager and refresh status manually.
job.pollPaused: Reading status or logs paused after an error. Refresh or retry reading manually.
job.mayHaveChanged: Global packages may have changed even if the operation failed or stopped. The inventory may be stale.
job.gateHeld: The operation still holds the machine-wide lock. Other operations are blocked. Once stopping finishes, retry process cleanup if offered; it never reruns the package command.
job.refreshRequired: The final inventory could not be verified. Refresh inventory after process cleanup; success is unconfirmed.

packageManagers.title: Project package manager version
packageManagers.scope: Changes only the packageManager declaration in this project's package.json. The npm/pnpm installed on this machine (global) does not change.
packageManagers.method: PkgSteward writes one field in package.json: no tool download, no install, no Corepack. Terminals follow the pin only if you use Corepack or pnpm's own version management.

packageManagers.lostNotice: The previous task can no longer be tracked. If it was a write, open package.json to check it before retrying.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize appearance, defaults, runtime scanning, and server options — stored cleanly inside one portable settings.json file.

validation.SCAN_ROOTS_WILDCARD: "*" must stand alone and cannot be mixed with directory paths.
validation.SCAN_ROOTS_ABSOLUTE: Paths must be absolute (for example D:\Projects or /home/user/projects).
validation.SCAN_ROOTS_TRAVERSAL: Paths must not contain ".." segments or NUL bytes.
validation.TIMEOUT_MIN_1000: Timeout must be an integer >= 1000 ms (1 second).
validation.DEPTH_RANGE: Scan depth must be an integer between 0 (unlimited) and 20 levels.
validation.SERVER_HOST: HOST must be a loopback address: 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1.
validation.SERVER_PORT: PORT must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
validation.SERVER_CORS: Each CORS origin must be a valid http:// or https:// scheme://host[:port] URL without wildcard * or path.
validation.WALLPAPER_URL_REQUIRED: Enter an external HTTPS image or video URL first.
validation.WALLPAPER_URL_HTTPS: Media URL must use a valid https:// address without embedded credentials.
validation.WALLPAPER_BLUR_RANGE: Backdrop blur must be an integer between 0 and 32 px.
validation.WALLPAPER_DIM_RANGE: Backdrop dim must be an integer between 0 and 85 %.
validation.WALLPAPER_SURFACE_RANGE: Card glass opacity must be an integer between 45 and 100 %.
validation.WALLPAPER_SPEED_RANGE: Animation speed must be an integer between 25 and 250 %.
validation.SURFACE_OPACITY_RANGE: Surface translucency must be an integer between 35 and 100 %.
validation.SURFACE_BLUR_RANGE: Glass blur radius must be an integer between 0 and 40 px.
validation.SURFACE_SATURATION_RANGE: Backdrop color saturation must be an integer between 100 and 220 %.
validation.TEXT_CUSTOM_COLOR_HEX: Custom text color must match #RRGGBB format (for example #F8FAFC).
validation.TEXT_SHADOW_BLUR_RANGE: Text shadow blur must be an integer between 0 and 24 px.
validation.TEXT_SHADOW_OPACITY_RANGE: Text shadow opacity must be an integer between 0 and 100 %.
validation.TEXT_OUTLINE_RANGE: Text outline thickness must be an integer between 0 and 3 px.
validation.PLUGIN_URL_REQUIRED: Enter a GitHub URL, npm:package specifier, or HTTPS link first.
validation.PLUGIN_NPM_SPEC: npm specifier must match npm:package or npm:@scope/package (optional @tag).
validation.PLUGIN_URL_INVALID: Plugin URL must be a valid https:// URL (or http:// loopback) without credentials.
validation.PLUGIN_DIR_TRAVERSAL: Directory path must not contain ".." segments or NUL bytes.
validation.PLUGIN_DIR_ABSOLUTE: Custom plugins directory must be an absolute path.
validation.PLUGIN_REGISTRIES_MAX: You can configure at most 20 trusted registries.
validation.PLUGIN_REGISTRIES_ORIGIN: Each trusted registry must be a clean https:// (or loopback http://) origin without paths.
validation.PLUGIN_CONFIG_NUMBER: Enter a valid finite number for this plugin setting.
validation.PLUGIN_CONFIG_STRING_TOO_LONG: Plugin text setting cannot exceed 1024 characters.
validation.BACKUP_EMPTY: Paste or choose a settings JSON file first.
validation.BACKUP_TOO_LARGE: Settings JSON exceeds the 256 KB size limit.

riskReason.PLUGIN_OVERWRITE: Replaces an existing installed plugin directory matching the same plugin ID.
riskReason.PLUGIN_UNINSTALL: Removes the plugin folder from disk (pre-installed plugins can be restored later).

appearance.surfaceSectionDescription: Adjust component translucency, frosted blur, backdrop color saturation, and Apple Liquid Glass specular edge highlights across cards, navigation bars, and dialogs.

surfaceStyleDescs.solid: Opaque panels with crisp classic contrast.
surfaceStyleDescs.frosted: Balanced translucent surface with subtle backdrop blur.
surfaceStyleDescs.liquid-glass: Apple-style refractive glass with rich saturation and luminous rims.
surfaceStyleDescs.crystal: Ultra-clear translucent panels maximizing background depth.

appearance.surfaceSolidHint: Choose Frosted Glass, Liquid Glass, or Crystal Clear above to activate translucent surfaces and live transparency tuning.
appearance.surfaceSolidDisabledHint: Select a glass preset above before tuning blur, saturation, or edge highlights.
appearance.surfaceSpecularDesc: Render Apple Liquid Glass crisp highlight edges, inner specular reflection, and soft layered depth.
appearance.previewFloatingDesc: Subtitle directly over the ambient background to test text shadow, color, and outline.
appearance.textSectionDescription: Automatically enhance text legibility against bright or busy backgrounds, or customize text color, drop shadow, and outline without changing your overall theme.

textModeDescs.auto: Recommended: applies crisp adaptive text shadow and boosts muted contrast over wallpapers.
textModeDescs.off: Keep standard typography without extra shadows, strokes, or color overrides.
textModeDescs.custom: Override ink polarity, custom text color, shadow intensity, and outline stroke.

appearance.textBoostMutedDesc: Raise muted label and path contrast so descriptions stay easy to read over busy images.
appearance.textCustomColorHint: Applied to headings, labels, and descriptions (keeping solid buttons & badges sharp).

behavior.generalDescription: Configure default language, runner terminal, and list behavior.
behavior.defaultShellLabel: Default console shell for project runs
behavior.defaultShellHint: Used when a project has not saved a per-project shell choice.
behavior.workflowDescription: Control how the workspace responds to navigation and focus changes.
behavior.autoRefreshDesc: Sync active job and scan status when returning to the window.
behavior.confirmNavigationDesc: Keep safety confirmations active while destructive actions are in progress.
behavior.showDesignSystemLabel: Show Design system in main navigation
behavior.showDesignSystemDesc: Turn off to hide the Design system showcase link from navigation menus.
behavior.paginationDescription: Configure how long tables and card lists slice pages without affecting filters or search results.
behavior.paginationEnabledDesc: Split large project, dependency, advisory, script, global package, and cleanup lists into manageable pages.
behavior.defaultPageSizeHint: Applied as the starting page size across supported lists. You can override per list anytime from the inline page-size selector.
behavior.showPageSizeSelectorDesc: Display a page size dropdown inside each list footer so you can adjust density per view.
behavior.scrollToTopLabel: Scroll to list top on page change
behavior.scrollToTopDesc: Smoothly scroll back to the top of the active list whenever you switch pages or page size.

runtime.hotReloadBanner: Settings below hot-reload immediately across PathGuard, Scanner, Projects, NpmRunner, Global Packages, and Package Managers without restarting the backend.
runtime.scanRootsDescription: Restrict which folders PkgSteward is allowed to scan and manage (protected system folders always remain blocked).
runtime.drivesPickerDescription: Tick one or more fixed drives whose non-protected folders will be scanned.
runtime.noDrivesDetected: No fixed drives detected on this system.
runtime.drivesRequired: Select at least one drive or switch scan mode.
runtime.allDrivesWarning: Wildcard "*" allows path access across all fixed drives (excluding protected system paths) and requires explicit high-risk confirmation.
runtime.customPathsRequired: Add at least one valid folder or switch to "*" mode.
runtime.limitsDescription: Configure directory walk depth and command timeout deadlines.
runtime.maxScanDepthHint: Set to 0 levels for unlimited depth; max 20 levels.

server.restartPendingBanner: Saved server settings ({fields}) differ from the running process. Restart the backend to apply.
server.restartInfoBanner: Edit server startup options directly in settings.json instead of maintaining .env manually. Restart the backend after saving for changes here to take effect.
server.configDescription: PkgSteward restricts network listeners to local loopback addresses only.
server.systemPathsDescription: Exact resolved locations for settings.json, audit logs, cache, and runtime directories.

plugins.foundationDescription: Supports standard plugin packages (manifest.json, package.json, Wallpaper Engine project.json, pkgsteward.plugin.json) with isolated preview & install.
plugins.masterEnableDesc: Persist plugin preferences and per-plugin config maps inside settings.json.
plugins.quickInstallDescription: Drop a plugin file/archive or paste a GitHub / npm / HTTPS link to preview and install without manual folder setup.
plugins.dropzoneLabel: Drop plugin package or media file
plugins.dropzoneHint: Drag & drop .zip, .tgz, .json, .html, image, or video here
plugins.supportedFormatsHint: Auto-detects manifest.json, package.json, Wallpaper Engine project.json, and pkgsteward.plugin.json.
plugins.installUrlLabel: Or install from GitHub link, npm:package, or HTTPS URL
plugins.securityDescription: Changing local discovery or custom directory permissions requires preview, PathGuard check, and audit logging.
plugins.allowLocalPluginsLabel: Allow discovering manifests from local plugin directories
plugins.allowLocalPluginsDesc: Reads top-level pkgsteward.plugin.json manifests only (symlink escapes blocked).
plugins.registriesLabel: Trusted registries (comma-separated HTTPS or loopback URLs)
plugins.noDiscovered: No valid pkgsteward.plugin.json manifests found in the active plugins directory.
plugins.sampleManifestTitle: Sample pkgsteward.plugin.json for future extension authors

backup.exportDescription: Download or copy a full settings.json snapshot (appearance, behavior, runtime, server, plugins) to back up or migrate to another machine / Electron desktop.
backup.importDescription: Accepts both structured settings.json backups and legacy flat key-value settings files. Validates and previews every diff before applying.
backup.resetDescription: Reset a chosen section (resetting Scan or Server removes overrides from settings.json so .env or system defaults take over).

safetyBanner.title: Read-only inspection — system-safe
safetyBanner.description: PkgSteward only reads installed runtimes and project configuration files. It never switches your machine-wide Node version, runs installers, or triggers UAC prompts.
